name.ja: HG 1/24 霊子戦闘機・無限(神山誠十郎機)
name.en: HG 1/24 Spirit Fighter Mugen (Seijuro Kamiyama machine)

description.ja: 『新サクラ大戦』より「霊子戦闘機・無限」をディテールにこだわって初プラモデル化！
description.en: From "New Sakura Wars ", " Reiko Fighter Mugen" is made into a plastic model for the first time with attention to detail!

description.ja: • 手・足の関節部分に伸縮を可能とする延長ギミックを搭載。アクションポーズの幅が広がる!
description.en: • Equipped with an extension gimmick that allows the joints of the hands and feet to expand and contract. Expands the range of action poses!

description.ja: • コックピット内部は設定を忠実に再現。
description.en: • The interior of the cockpit faithfully reproduces the settings.

description.ja: • コックピットハッチ開閉ギミックを搭載！
description.en: • Equipped with cockpit hatch opening/closing gimmick!

description.ja: • 搭乗姿のキャラクターフィギュアが付属。
description.en: • A character figure in boarding form is included.
